executable.name: aichallenge_awsim_eval
executable.cmd: prlimit --as=$(var mem_awsim) taskset -c $(var cpu_awsim) bash /aichallenge/run_simulator.bash parallel

executable.name: autoware_d1
executable.cmd: prlimit --as=$(var mem_d1) taskset -c $(var cpu_d1) bash -c 'mkdir -p '$(var log_dir)'/d1 && cd '$(var log_dir)'/d1 && source /aichallenge/workspace/install/setup.bash && source /aichallenge/d1/workspace/install/setup.bash && exec ros2 launch aichallenge_system_launch aichallenge_system.launch.xml simulation:=true use_sim_time:=true run_rviz:=false capture:=true rosbag:=true domain_id:=1 > '$(var log_dir)'/d1/autoware.log 2>&1'

executable.name: autoware_d2
executable.cmd: prlimit --as=$(var mem_d2) taskset -c $(var cpu_d2) bash -c '[ -f /aichallenge/d2/workspace/install/setup.bash ] || exit 0; mkdir -p '$(var log_dir)'/d2 && cd '$(var log_dir)'/d2 && source /aichallenge/workspace/install/setup.bash && source /aichallenge/d2/workspace/install/setup.bash && exec ros2 launch aichallenge_system_launch aichallenge_system.launch.xml simulation:=true use_sim_time:=true run_rviz:=false capture:=false rosbag:=false domain_id:=2 > '$(var log_dir)'/d2/autoware.log 2>&1'

executable.name: autoware_d3
executable.cmd: prlimit --as=$(var mem_d3) taskset -c $(var cpu_d3) bash -c '[ -f /aichallenge/d3/workspace/install/setup.bash ] || exit 0; mkdir -p '$(var log_dir)'/d3 && cd '$(var log_dir)'/d3 && source /aichallenge/workspace/install/setup.bash && source /aichallenge/d3/workspace/install/setup.bash && exec ros2 launch aichallenge_system_launch aichallenge_system.launch.xml simulation:=true use_sim_time:=true run_rviz:=false capture:=false rosbag:=false domain_id:=3 > '$(var log_dir)'/d3/autoware.log 2>&1'
